_about: Enemy factions. Archetype-based: each has a signature behaviour and a tactical answer, not an element. pattern is the foe sequence a squad unpacks into, cycled to the squad's strength.

entries.name: The Risen
entries.fantasy: There are more of them than there are bullets, and the ones you already shot are getting back up.
entries.signature: Numerous, weak, and they return unless finished.
entries.flavour: Gate order four: nothing that has died passes the wall. Nothing.

entries.name: The Furnace Host
entries.fantasy: Everything they do is loud, on fire, and telegraphed from a mile away. That does not make it survivable.
entries.signature: Hard hits on a telegraph. Fire and energy.
entries.flavour: Recruitment poster: THEY BROUGHT FIRE. WE BROUGHT BIGGER FIRE.

entries.name: The Chorus
entries.fantasy: They do not fight the rules. They edit them.
entries.signature: Bends the rules: corrupts faces, scrambles rerolls, swaps ranks.
entries.flavour: Field manual, appendix K: a face on the die that was never installed means the machine is compromised. Fight on.
